The second season finale of Celebrity Traitors U.K. airs today, Oct. 30, 2026. Hosted again by broadcaster Claudia Winkleman and renewed for three more years , viewers across Britain can watch the show on BBC One and BBC iPlayer while viewers overseas can use a VPN to connect through a U.K. server and access services that restrict viewing by location.
Last year, season one of the U.K.-based show became a major TV hit, with the finale seeing comedian Alan Carr come out on top in front of a record-breaking 12 million BBC viewers . This season also had plenty of reasons to keep that momentum going, with a cast that boasts an unusually long A-list lineup. Where to Watch The Celebrity Traitors U.K. Online
The Celebrity Traitors U.K. Season 2 finale will air on BBC One and BBC iPlayer on Friday, Oct. 30 at 12 p.m. PT/3 p.m. ET.
Watch The Celebrity Traitors U.K. Finale Online With a VPN
Viewers outside of the United Kingdom will need a VPN to watch The Celebrity Traitors since BBC One and BBC iPlayer are intended for viewers in the U.K.
A VPN works by routing your internet connection through a server in another location, giving websites a different apparent IP address. By connecting to a U.K. server, your connection can appear to come from Britain rather than your actual location.

The Odds for the Celebrity Traitors 2026 Finale
According to the latest odds from analytics platform The Action Network , comedian and presenter Romesh Ranganathan is now leading the race to win the second series of The Celebrity Traitors , with odds of 15/8 and a 35% implied probability of victory. Singer-songwriter James Blunt follows in second place at 3/1 (25%), while actor and singer-songwriter Sebastian Croft ranks third at 4/1 (20%). Social media personality King Kenny rounds out the top contenders at 11/2 (15%).
Meanwhile, broadcaster and entrepreneur Maya Jama is the heavy favorite to face the next banishment, with odds of 5/6 and a 55% implied probability, followed by singer Leigh-Anne Pinnock at 7/3 (30%) and King Kenny at 11/2 (15%). Actor Michael Sheen is favored to become the Traitors’ seventh and final murder victim at even odds of 1/1 (50%), with Sebastian Croft next in line at 3/1 (25%). As for the overall outcome, Team Faithful is heavily favored to win the series, while Team Traitors trails behind at 15/8.
These odds provide a snapshot of how the competition could unfold ahead of the finale, scheduled to air on Friday, Oct. 30, 2026, at 8 p.m. GMT (12 p.m. PT/3 p.m. ET) on BBC One and BBC iPlayer, although the remaining contestants still have time to change their fortunes.

The Traitors is a reality competition built around deception, deduction and trust. A group of contestants lives and competes together while secretly being divided into Faithfuls and Traitors. The Faithfuls must identify the Traitors before they are eliminated, while the Traitors secretly remove players and try to reach the end undetected. Each round brings new missions, suspicions, alliances and accusations.
